name: libjaylink
why: Talks to SEGGER J-Link debug probes; a real door into JTAG and SWD hardware debugging.

brief.what_it_is: libjaylink is a C library that provides interoperability with SEGGER J-Link hardware, according to the project's short description. The fetched GitLab page showed only the project name, its GNU LGPLv2.1 license, a CHANGELOG link, and a creation date. The README body did not load, so I could not confirm what the library takes in or what it returns. The scout note describes it as talking to J-Link debug probes as a route into JTAG and SWD hardware debugging.
brief.why_it_exists: The short description says it exists to provide interoperability with JLINK hardware. The README did not load, so I have no author's own framing.
brief.install_notes: Nothing confirmed. The fetched pages contained no build or install instructions, and the README did not load.
brief.standout: It is a free, LGPL-licensed library for talking to SEGGER J-Link probes, which are usually driven through SEGGER's proprietary tooling. That makes it a candidate for open-source debug-probe work. This is from the description and scout note, not from the README.
brief.status: unknown. The only dated evidence is a creation date of October 29, 2019. I found no release date, last commit, or README note about maintenance.
brief.caveats: The README and docs did not load, so this brief is thin. The homepage is hosted on a self-managed GitLab instance (gitlab.zapb.de), not GitHub. Nothing was verified about platform support, supported J-Link models, or build requirements. The license is GNU LGPLv2.1, as shown on the project page.
